title: Asymptotically Self-Similar Blowup for 3D Incompressible Euler with $C^{1, 1/3-}$ Velocity I: $C^{\infty}$ 1D Limiting Profiles
summary: We consider a one-parameter family of 1D models for the 3D axisymmetric incompressible Euler equation with $C^α$ vorticity and without swirl near the symmetry axis. For $α= \frac13$, we impose a crucial normalization and construct a $C^{\infty}$ self-similar blowup profile with unbounded 1D stream function and infinite spatial blowup rate, using a fixed-point argument around a numerically constructed approximate profile.
